import hashlib,os,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from fixture_area import fixture_area
# Freeze the declared production image under a fixture path: source-managed
# bin/swarm would trigger another build when the lifecycle test calls start.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='p0-image-',dir=fixture_area()) as d:
    binary=Path(d)/'swarm'
    shutil.copy2('bin/swarm',binary)
    print('FIXTURE_IMAGE_SHA256 '+hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
    result=subprocess.run(['python3','-m','unittest','test_local_status_lock','test_swarm_local.LocalWeb.test_status_during_lifecycle_mutation_preserves_live_identity','-v'],env={**os.environ,'SWARM_TEST_BINARY':str(binary.resolve())})
    raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
